name: Wolf Simulator: Pack & Prey
summary:
Become a wolf and answer the call of the wild.

Wolf Simulator: Pack & Prey is a quest-driven animal adventure where each level brings a new hunt, a new objective, and a new challenge. Explore wilderness environments, pursue different animals, and complete missions to continue your journey.
